name: resumotion-repo
description: Repo-level scripts: package the skill zip and validate it.

scripts.package: zip -r resumotion.zip resumotion/ && echo '✓ resumotion.zip created' && unzip -l resumotion.zip | head -6
scripts.zip-check: unzip -l resumotion.zip | awk 'NR>3{print $4}' | grep -v '^resumotion/' | grep -v '^$' | grep -v 'files' && echo 'all entries start with resumotion/ ✓' || true
